summary: Examines address resolution problems that appear when data centers grow to very large numbers of hosts. It focuses on ARP for IPv4 and Neighbor Discovery for IPv6, and describes the scaling issues they can cause. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If thousands of people in a huge hall all shout who has this name to find a friend, it gets noisy. This describes that noise problem in giant computer rooms.

questions: why does arp not scale in large data centers
what are neighbor discovery problems in data centers
